checkpoints.SA-1A: blocked in part: full MongoDB advisory coverage and remaining image reachability validation
checkpoints.SA-1B: pass for exercised bounded assessment; untested cases separately disclosed

items.title: Runtime image advisory candidates need component-specific verification
items.boundary: Understand risk of executable runtime dependencies
items.prerequisites: Candidate-specific affected feature and reachable attacker input or local privilege conditions
items.observed: 880 package/advisory matches across four images; 218 distinct advisory IDs; workspace audits report zero advisories
items.publicSeverity: requires actual deployment and feature reachability analysis
items.proposal: Verify affected components and approve compatible image maintenance or unnecessary runtime-tool removal

items.title: Blind asset creation from another loopback browser origin
items.boundary: Unrelated browser content versus intended local user actions
items.prerequisites: Attacker-controlled page on another loopback origin and active local application
items.expected: Evaluate write admission independently of CORS response confidentiality
items.observed: One synthetic asset inserted; script could not read response. Synthetic public HTTPS origin denied loopback access; JSON/PUT preflights rejected
items.localSeverity: low potential blind insertion impact; overlaps trusted-local-host assumption
items.publicSeverity: unproven; no real public-origin or DNS-rebinding exploit demonstrated
items.proposal: Decide whether Origin/Host admission policy is required; preserve native and supported same-origin callers

items.title: Aggregate retained resources have no application quota
items.boundary: Bound work and storage according to supported local use
items.prerequisites: Repeated intentional valid requests or separately proven unwanted request path
items.observed: Three additional images and six distinct inspections retained; individual input/slot limits and cleanup held
items.publicSeverity: untrusted sustained admission requires policy and capacity assessment
items.proposal: Define admission/retention requirements without deleting uncertain published assets

items.title: Host and framing policies are not explicitly restricted
items.boundary: HTTP host/origin assumptions and browser UI context
items.prerequisites: Host acceptance alone does not establish DNS resolution or browser-origin exploit chain
items.observed: Synthetic arbitrary Host returned health 200; loopback page framed SPA without document read access
items.proposal: Select Host and framing policy only with explicit compatibility requirements

items.title: Public image caching and URL logs assume synthetic local data
items.boundary: Image and operational-data confidentiality under chosen sensitivity requirements
items.prerequisites: Introduction of sensitive images or secret-bearing request URLs
items.observed: One-year public immutable image caching; dummy query marker present in local request logs; no real secret used
items.proposal: Choose cache/logging privacy requirements and targeted regressions if real data is intended

items.title: Supply chain and service authority retain local-demo assumptions
items.prerequisites: Compromised upstream action/image or already compromised local service
items.observed: Read-only workflow permission, frozen installs and non-root app processes; tagged Actions, bundled npm, shared bridge and database authority remain
items.proposal: Approve narrow immutable pins and runtime restrictions with compatibility checks; no new infrastructure

items.title: Input, query and projection controls held in exercised cases
items.boundary: Untrusted API fields versus explicit queries and public DTOs
items.observed: Malformed/operator-shaped/extra fields rejected; bounded queries and projection assertions passed
items.proposal: Retain regression controls; no fix indicated by these cases

items.title: Canonicalization, paths and staging cleanup held
items.boundary: Uploaded bytes and filenames versus canonical private storage
items.observed: Format/frame/pixel/size checks, metadata stripping, hostile filename, abort cleanup and slot release passed
items.proposal: Preserve checks; privileged local storage writer remains outside guarantee

items.title: Worker and review data-integrity guards held
items.boundary: Duplicate/stale attempts and conflicting human edits versus authoritative state
items.observed: 139 selected integration cases passed; immutable predictions, CAS, receipt eviction, attempts and uncertain acknowledgements retained
items.proposal: Retain deterministic barriers and finite budgets; no exactly-once or immutable audit-history promise

items.title: Private operators and runtime storage permissions observed
items.boundary: Public application routes versus process-local operators and protected files
items.observed: Public API operator paths 404; loopback-only operators; UID 1000 API/worker and UID 101 web; worker image mount read-only
items.proposal: Keep these constraints in later regression gates

items.title: Dockerfile-only missing HEALTHCHECK alert
items.observed: Trivy DS-0026 warning; actual Compose deployment defines all five health checks
items.proposal: No application fix or global suppression

items.title: nginx 200 SPA responses mistaken for exposed operators
items.observed: Original two expectations failed; follow-up proves HTML fallback, no metric series, and direct API 404
items.proposal: Correct audit expectation only; preserve original failure evidence

items.title: Debian zlib1g MiniZip advisory match
items.observed: Three image appearances of CVE-2023-45853 against a binary package without the affected MiniZip contribution
items.proposal: Close this package-specific match without suppressing other zlib/MiniZip cases

items.title: Advisory and deployment coverage gaps
items.observed: MongoDB full image above audit size limit; fallback unsupported. Full filtered history, hosted settings, other browsers, actual DNS rebinding and optional platform integration not completed
items.proposal: Preserve gaps; agree safe additional assessment methods before stronger claims
